blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Love is complicated, and as the Supreme Court (SC) once said, the state’s criminal justice system is a clumsy instrument for mending a broken heart. In an en banc decision promulgated June 3, 2026 penned by Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen, the SC nullified a 2009 warrantless arrest of a wife and her fitness trainer who were accused of adultery. The SC also formally transmitted a copy of its ruling to the Office of the President, the Senate president, and the speaker of the House.
